title: Flowcheck 1:1 play slate - Rhea prep
body:
Context: 30-minute weekly 1:1 with Asha (senior infra SWE). Focus = unblock shipping of KV-cache eviction feature, career coaching, and capacity planning for next sprint. Asha has been heads-down on ENG-3421 (KV eviction) + pairing occasionally with Devina on rollout testing.

Goals for this meeting (ranked):
- Clear blockers on ENG-3421 so we can merge and start canary by Friday (concrete next steps).
- Surface any hidden technical debt slowing down on-call rotations.
- Discuss Asha's interest in stepping into a tech-ld role for Dedicated rollout (ask about time, willingness, and risk appetite).
- Quick sync on career path / promotion rubric items to align expectations.

30-min agenda (timeboxed):
1) 0-6m — Warm check-in (energy, context, triage anything urgent). Note to self: ask about sleep/feelings (small human check).
2) 6-16m — Blockers deep-dive: ENG-3421 status, failing integration tests, deployment gating. Ask: what specifically is failing on canary? Who on QA owns the scenario?
3) 16-22m — Priorities & capacity: next sprint assignment trade-offs; can Asha carve 20% for Dedicated rollout leadership?
4) 22-28m — Career / feedback: one concrete strength, one growth area; agree on 2-week experiment for cross-team leadership exposure.
5) 28-30m — Action items + quick wins. Confirm follow-ups and handoffs.

Notes-to-self / prompts to use:
- "Walk me through where the test flakes are happening, show the failing log line."
- "If we can't unblock by EOD Friday, what's our rollback plan?"
- "What would you need from me to run the Dedicated rollout as tech lead for the next month?"
- "Which oncall rotations feel brittle — list top 2 pain points."

Current signals & quick data (grab before meeting):
- CI failures for ENG-3421: 7 failing builds in the last 24h (pipeline A, step 'warmup-cache').
- Canary latency increased 8% on stg-3 after last merge (check telemetry dashboard).
- Oncall page ops #s: 4 high-severity incidents in past 30 days, 2 attributed to cache behavior.

Potential blocker hypotheses to test in meeting:
- Eviction policy mismatch with long-lived KV entries -> memory pressure in runtime.
- Race in async writeback causing intermittency in integration tests.
- Test harness insufficiently mocking GPU-backed latency -> flakes on CI.

Action items (draft, assign now):
- Asha: isolate failing test case & push minimal repro to feature branch (due: 2027-09-20).
- Rhea: ping QA lead (Devina) to prioritize regression scenario and offer 2 test hours (due: 2027-09-19).
- Asha + Devina: schedule 30m pairing for Friday AM to run canary tests together (calendar invite).
- Rhea: prepare a short brief for Eng Leads about Dedicated rollout scope/expectations (due: 2027-09-24).

Follow-ups to confirm in meeting:
- Does Asha want to run a 2-week rotation as tech lead? If yes, scope the minimal deliverables and time allocation.
- Confirm owner for the rollback plan if canary regresses.
- Agree on one concrete metric to watch for stability (e.g., 99th p99 latency for cache-lookup).

Risks & escalations:
- If cannot resolve test flakes by 2027-09-22, prepare to pause canary and run a full regression window (impact: 1 sprint delay).
- If Asha is overloaded, we need to backfill oncall tasks; consider temporary hire / contractor for test automation (raise to people ops).

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send quickly after 1:1):
- Subject: 1:1 notes + action items (Asha) — {date}
- Body: Short recap (top 3 decisions), action list with owners & dates, calendar invites attached, links to repro + CI logs, ask if I missed anything.

Personal coaching prompts:
- Encourage Asha to lead a short demo for the team next Wed (15 min) to build visibility.
- Suggest block of 'deep focus' on calendar twice next week (label: DEEP:KV-EVICT).

Unresolved questions to bring to leads/PMs after sync:
- Is Dedicated rollout timeline flexible by 2 weeks if Asha shifts focus? (ask PM: Mira)
- Budget for short-term QA contractor to accelerate regression coverage? (ask Eng Ops)

Quick checklist before the meeting:
- Pull last 24h CI logs for ENG-3421 (yes)
- Open telemetry dashboard to p99 latency for stg-3 (yes)
- Pre-draft action items (done)
- Calendar invite set for 30m (done)

"Notes to self" final: keep it light and solution-oriented. If Asha brings up burnout, prioritize mental bandwidth over new leadership ask. Close with a concrete tiny win so they leave motivated (e.g., agree to pair on first CANARY run).

-- Rhea
